# ExecFile <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">

```blitzbasic
ExecFile:Void command:String
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `command` | In | String | required | The command line to run. It is run by the system shell. |

**Returns:** 1 when the command ran and ended without an error, otherwise 0.

## Description

Runs a command or another program and waits until it ends.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
Print ExecFile("this-program-does-not-exist")
```

```text
0
```
